question: The Karve committee was formed in ______.
solution: The correct answer is __**1955**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Karve Committee** was established in **1955** to study the implementation of community development programs and the National Extension Service in India. • The committee, headed by **D.R. Gadgil** (popularly known as the Karve Committee), aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of these programs and suggest improvements. • It played a crucial role in shaping policies related to **rural development** and evaluating the reach of government initiatives in **rural areas**. • The committee focused on identifying gaps in resource allocation, administrative efficiency, and the participation of local communities in developmental activities. • The recommendations of the Karve Committee laid the foundation for **future rural development schemes** in India, ensuring equitable distribution and effective program implementation.
